components.name: boost
components.description: Header-only usage (Asio, Beast, core) by olv_backend and olv_sim; not vendored, expected as a system/toolchain dependency (see THIRD_PARTY.md). Version is the boost-devel package (1.83.0-7.el10) in the olv-builder image (containers/Dockerfile.builder, rockylinux:10.2) that the shipped binaries are built in.

components.name: open-dis-cpp
components.description: IEEE 1278.1 DIS Entity State PDUs: decode for olv_backend's --input-mode dis, encode for olv_sim's --protocol dis. Built from the pinned upstream release (sha256-verified tarball) with upstream's own CMake project, no local modifications, and installed into /usr/local of the olv-builder image by containers/Dockerfile.builder; only the DIS6 static library is linked (see THIRD_PARTY.md).
